summary: Iteration 10 frontend-only re-test focused on the missing warm-orange rim from iteration 9. Both warm-orange and cool-blue accents are now PRESENT on the rendered robot (pixel sampling of mv.toDataURL: warm 17.7%, cool 48.6%, neutral 33.7% on a 560x584 canvas over ~15k robot pixels; avg RGB 174/175/180). The key acceptance criterion (BOTH warm and cool rims visible on a light-gray body) PASSES. All iteration-9 behaviors continue to pass: robot fully visible & centered on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844, ~335x388), upright with base at the bottom, breathing room top/bottom; camera-target='auto' (single token, corrected); auto-rotate spins around center; a long deliberate mouse drag does NOT open the modal; a discrete click on hero-featured-card opens the Cobot Ultrasonic Welding Automation modal; hero-featured-chip opens the same modal; Escape closes cleanly. No regressions: Navbar (Home/Projects/Timeline/About Me) present, 4 project cards, 8 timeline items (timeline-item-0..7) with timeline-cobot-link testid intact, Resume module with QR + 'Scan or View PDF' visible. Console shows only benign warnings (WebGL ReadPixels stall from our own toDataURL sampling, model-viewer HDRJPGLoader SDR notice, Lit dev-mode) — no real errors.

issues: Cool-blue rim now dominates: cool ~48.6% vs warm ~17.7% (spec asked for roughly 8-14% each). Both accents ARE visible (primary acceptance met), but the robot reads more cool/blue-white than balanced light-gray in the desktop screenshot. Consider tempering the blue lobe intensity in studio-env.png (or nudging the orange lobe brighter) so cool/warm proportions are closer to parity.

action_items: Optional polish: rebalance studio-env.png so cool-blue rim is less dominant (currently ~48% of non-background pixels read cool while warm reads ~18%). Aim closer to warm~cool parity in the 8-14% band per user's original spec.
No blocking issues — the primary iteration-9 failure (0% warm orange) is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: camera-target='auto' is now correct single-token form (was 'auto auto auto' previously).

environment-image is still a .png interpreted via HDRJPGLoader (SDR fallback log). Functionally fine now that both rims read; a real .hdr equirect would remove the console notice and give truer HDR IBL.

Click-vs-drag: with a substantial drag (>=300px) the click handler does not fire; very short drags (~250px, fast) may still register as click. UX is acceptable but a pointerdown/up distance threshold would be more robust.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of acceptance criteria (both warm+cool rims visible, sizing/centering/rotate/drag/click/chip/regressions all pass). One minor design polish suggested (cool dominates warm).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Warm 17.7% / Cool 48.6% / Neutral 33.7% via mv.toDataURL sampling on desktop; robot boxed at 560x583 within hero, mobile 335x388. hero-featured-card click and hero-featured-chip click both open Cobot modal; long drag (>=300px) does NOT open modal. Timeline testids are timeline-item-0..7 (not timeline-milestone-*).
rca of the issue: iteration_9 root cause (studio-env.png being decoded as SDR + low metallicFactor + exposure=1.0 causing warm-orange rim to be invisible) is now mitigated by: metallicFactor 0.15->0.34, exposure 1.0->1.18, and regenerated studio-env.png with brighter, repositioned orange+blue rim lobes. Result: both accents now register on the rendered canvas.
